draft_probability_model.interpretation: Probability that the player occupies one of the 140 JUGG draft slots, calibrated to sum to 140 across the supported 2026 pool.

metadata.interpretation: Price is conditional on being drafted; draft_probability is a separate model output. Neither is a production value.
metadata.scoring_eligibility: Player has a 2026 ESPN Salary Cap Value or Yahoo ADP; deeper canonical players are excluded as outside the historical model's supported sale-price population.
